div.div: حُوقٌ The [corona or] surrounding edges of the glans of the penis; (S, K;) as also ↓ حَوْقٌ , (Ibn- 'Abbád, K,) which is a rare dial. var., (TA,) and ↓ حُوَقٌ : (Ibn-' Abbád, TA:) or ↓ حَوْقٌ , (K, TA,) with fet-h, (TA,) [in the CK حُوق,] signifies a roundness in the penis. (Th, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
